text:
jordan: Quick sync — we're targeting a rollout of model-serving v2 tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:30 PT. Need telemetry gating: two dashboard cards, trace sampling bump for the canary, and alert threshold adjustments. Who's deploying and who will own rollback readiness?

maya: I'm on deploy. I'll be on call during the window. Can someone own dashboard updates and trace config?

tariq: I can handle trace sampling. Suggest sampling_rate from 0.05 -> 0.1 for the canary nodes only. Will push change to telemetry-config (canary tag). Also adding a span tag `model_version`.

rachel: I'll update dashboards. Which panels need attention? p50/p95 latency, token throughput, error-rate by model?

jordan: Yep — p50, p95, requests/sec, model.error.rate. Set p95 alert to 1.5x baseline over 15m, and a hard abort if errors > 3% sustained 5m. Also add a compare-to-baseline panel and a canary filter.

rachel: Will add compare panel and a canary filter by node-group. Draft dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/serving-rollout?view=canary (draft).

sam: CI green. DeployBot queued: `/deploy service/serving v2 --canary 10% --start 09:30PT`

deploy-bot: Deploy request received. Preflight checks: k8s health ok, infra quotas ok. Approvers needed: @sre-oncall, @maya.

sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring. Preflight checklist: (1) dashboards live, (2) trace sampling applied, (3) canary routing 10% verified, (4) rollback playbook accessible. Ping me when ready for go.

maya: I'll run the smoke script right before rollout. Quick runbook command: ```./scripts/smoke-serve.sh --target canary --duration 3m``` I'll paste results here.

amy: Code review ping — PR #452 has the small logging change for `model_version` tag. Merge pending.

tariq: Trace config pushed to canary namespace. Sampling ramp scripted: `telemetryctl set-sampling --namespace canary --rate 0.1` — tested in staging, looks fine.

rachel: Dashboard panels added, set to 60s refresh. Added grafana alert rule `serving_p95_above_expected` eval 15m threshold 1.5x baseline. Also created a muted escalation for now (no pager until canary verified).

maya: Smoke run (canary): all checks green, p95 stable, token throughput within 5% of baseline. Short output: ```OK: canary qps 120 +/-6% | errors 0.6%```

jordan: Great. @sre-oncall — ready for go at 09:30? Reminder: abort/rollback if p95 >1.5x or errors >3%.

sre-oncall: Ready. I'll watch dashboards and traces. If thresholds breached I'll trigger rollback and notify Execs. Assigning watchers: @tariq, @rachel, @maya. I'll also stash the rollback playbook link in the incident channel.

jordan: Thanks team. I'll update the release calendar and send the calendar invite for handoff.

rachel: One small follow-up — after canary we should reduce trace sampling back to baseline after 30m of steady metrics. I'll add a note in the dashboard description.

tariq: Sounds good. I'll put a scheduled job to revert sampling: `telemetryctl set-sampling --namespace canary --rate 0.05 --at 10:30PT` if no issues.

maya: All set from my side. Will post final smoke logs at T-5. :thumbsup:
